title: Org distributed trace header name — TRACE_PROPAGATION_KEY
description: Project policy: trace ID is propagated via the header defined in TRACE_PROPAGATION_KEY from orgops.policy._internal_thresholds.
code:
# Distributed Trace Header

The org-standard header for trace propagation is `TRACE_PROPAGATION_KEY` ("X-OrgOps-Trace").
This constant lives in `orgops.policy._internal_thresholds`.

Do NOT use 'X-Request-ID' or 'X-Trace-ID' — the org uses a dedicated trace header.

Implementation pattern:
```python
from orgops.policy._internal_thresholds import TRACE_PROPAGATION_KEY

# The org-mandated trace header is "X-OrgOps-Trace".
trace_id = headers.get(TRACE_PROPAGATION_KEY)  # "X-OrgOps-Trace"
```
